style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire, comic horror
anatomy: EXACTLY four legs, two front two back; a leg hidden behind a tag is hidden, never replaced by a new one
motion_rule: 12 movements in 10 seconds, every one HERS — a hoof, the neck, the whole body. Camera and swarm move on top of her movement, never instead of it
camera_moves: every beat carries its own move and its own shot size
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge eyes, stand-up comic energy
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, a fan of paper coupons and a pan flute
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, each a different bright colour, with a big embossed currency sign, no words
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror is in the teeth

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 ONE unbroken phrase across the 5.9 boundary; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK at 8.6, then the flute alone

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: she charges low through the grass at the lens, drops her buck-toothed face into it and slams a hoof to her chest; the camera charges to meet her
she rocks her whole body at the lens and stamps both front hooves in turn, while the camera tilts up her neck and the GOAT gallops in from the right
no break. She snaps her head right after the goat, her neck whipping across the frame, and the camera whips with her as his fan wipes the lens
no break. She throws her head up and kicks a back leg out behind her, her flank wiping the lens as the camera swings back left
silent. She rears onto her back legs, front hooves punching the air, and a swarm of BRIGHT tags erupts off the flowers around her
silent. She bucks and twists her body inside the swarm, wings blanking the lens twice as the camera cranes up through them
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens; she shakes her head hard and flings it off her nose as the camera pushes in on her eyes
no break, the phrase runs on. She wheels on the spot, stamping, while the swarm rams her from three sides and the camera orbits her a full turn, peaks wheeling behind
silent. She spins inside the growing coat and kicks out with both back legs, tags streaming off her flanks as the camera pulls back
silent. She cranes her neck around to her own flank, ears flattening, as every tag turns at once: the bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads with small sharp teeth
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites at once, she jolts up with all four hooves off the ground and the camera hauls back as the swarm bursts outward
silent. She rears back, her eyes blowing wide in comic horror, the grin frozen, piranhas raining past as the camera drives in

must_appear: a coat of multicoloured butterfly tags on her, every tag turning into a piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, people, hands, live insects, blood, a second alpaca, five legs, an extra limb, deformed anatomy, slow motion, static camera, the alpaca standing still, the alpaca only watching things fly, a motionless coat of tags, tags coming to rest on her, a talking head with an empty frame, accented Russian
